sections.title: Professional Development in Higher Education
sections.description: To prepare for a career in higher education administration, this course emphasizes practical application of theory and skill development. The course provides an overview of different careers in higher education, equips students with tools to embark on a successful job search, offers networking opportunities with administrators in higher education, and introduces students to relevant and timely literature and resources in higher education professional development.

sections.title: Professional Development in Higher Education
sections.description: To prepare for a career in higher education, students are engaged in a 20-hour a week assistantship in the field. This course complements and enhances the graduate assistantship. Emphasizing practical application of theory and skill development, the course does the following: provides students with tools to embark on a successful job search; offers networking opportunities with administrators in higher education; and introduces students to relevant and timely literature and resources in higher education professional development.
